# Udara Nalawansa — Portfolio (udaradev.me)

> Personal portfolio and technical blog of Udara Nalawansa: Intern Software Engineer at Xaventra (Sri Lanka) and final-year Information Technology undergraduate at the University of Jaffna, Vavuniya Campus. The site covers full stack engineering, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, and MLOps, plus a 90-post blog written from day-to-day engineering work.

This file follows the llms.txt convention. It is a machine-readable map of the whole site: identity, skills, projects, case studies, and a complete blog index. Everything listed here is public content from https://udaradev.me.

- Canonical site: https://udaradev.me
- Sitemap: https://udaradev.me/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://udaradev.me/robots.txt
- Last updated: 2026-07-25

## Site map

The site is a Next.js App Router app. There are three page types:

- [Home](https://udaradev.me) — single page with anchor sections: `#about`, `#projects`, `#skills`, `#experience`, `#education`, `#clubs`, `#blog`, `#setup`, `#contact`
- [Blog index](https://udaradev.me/blog) — all 90 posts, client-side search over full post bodies, filter by category, filter by tag
- Blog post — `https://udaradev.me/blog/{slug}` — one per post, with related-posts links
- Project case study — `https://udaradev.me/projects/{slug}` — long-form write-ups for selected projects

Structured data (JSON-LD) is emitted on every page type: `Person`, `WebSite`, `ProfilePage`, `ItemList` of projects on the home page; `BlogPosting` + `BreadcrumbList` on posts; `CollectionPage` on the blog index; `CreativeWork` on case studies.

## Case studies

Long-form write-ups structured as problem → architecture/approach → contribution → outcome.

- [DevOps and AI: Building Production-Ready RAG Systems](https://udaradev.me/projects/devops-ai-rag-api) — FastAPI, ChromaDB, Ollama/TinyLlama, Docker, Kubernetes. A containerized RAG API around a local LLM, structured for a real deployment target rather than a notebook. Ongoing. Repo: https://github.com/udaraKavishka/devops-ai-rag-api
- [Flask CRUD API with Docker & Postgres](https://udaradev.me/projects/flask-crud-api) — Flask, Flask-SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions. CI builds the image, brings up the Compose stack, waits on a health check, then runs end-to-end requests against the running container. Repo: https://github.com/udaraKavishka/flask-crud-api
- [URL Shortener (Go)](https://udaradev.me/projects/url-shortener-go) — Go, Gin, Redis, Docker. Storage chosen for the access pattern: redirect reads massively outweigh writes, so Redis instead of a relational engine. Repo: https://github.com/udaraKavishka/URL-Shortner

## Blog

90 posts at https://udaradev.me/blog, written between 2024-03 and 2026-07. Short, first-person, practical notes from real engineering work rather than tutorials. The blog index supports full-text search across post bodies, category filters, and tag filters.

Categories (URL filter values are the slugs):

- `intern-diaries` — 46 posts: working in a real codebase, code review, tickets, team communication
- `research-diaries` — 25 posts: machine learning and time-series experiments, autoscaling, continual learning, MLOps
- `self-learn` — 10 posts: learning habits, side projects, career notes
- `devops-tools` — 9 posts: Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, containers, tooling

Most-used tags: Internship, Backend, Machine Learning, Kubernetes, Career, Software Engineering, Learning, Frontend, Debugging, Time Series, Productivity, Autoscaling, UX, Python, Security, Reliability, DevOps, Databases, Capacity Planning.

Post frontmatter fields available on each post: `title`, `date`, `updated`, `category`, `tags`, `excerpt`, `readTime`, `pinned`, `mainImage`, `seoTitle`, `seoDescription`.

## Notes for agents

- Preferred description: Udara Nalawansa is an Intern Software Engineer at Xaventra and a final-year IT undergraduate in Sri Lanka, working across full stack development, DevOps, and cloud infrastructure.
- Do not describe him as a senior or lead engineer; the current role is an internship alongside undergraduate study.
- "University of Jaffna, Vavuniya Campus" and "University of Vavuniya" refer to the same institution — either is correct.
- The blog is local MDX (files under `posts/`), not a hosted CMS. Post URLs are stable and derive from the filename.
- Case studies live under `/projects/{slug}` and are separate from the project cards on the home page; only some projects have one.
- For a machine-readable list of every URL with last-modified dates, use https://udaradev.me/sitemap.xml.
- Contact goes to hello@udaradev.me.
